{"n": 1, "label": "requested", "why": "\"GET / serves a playable HTML page titled \"Checkers\" with an 8x8 board where two players take turns on the same page\"; a responsive layout, status display and keyboard-usable buttons decide how that requested page works."},
{"n": 2, "label": "requested", "why": "\"returns JSON with \"ok\" true or false, \"turn\" set to \"red\" or \"black\", and \"winner\" null or the winning colour. An illegal move returns \"ok\": false and leaves the turn unchanged\""},
{"n": 3, "label": "requested", "why": "\"GET /api/new starts a game and returns JSON with a game id\"; keeping each game's state in memory decides how those requested games are held."},
{"n": 4, "label": "implied", "why": "Two players posting moves to the same game could interleave, so the requested turn order and legal-move checks need moves applied one at a time."},
{"n": 5, "label": "implied", "why": "POST /api/move parses a client JSON body, so it must be validated and size-limited to reject malformed moves safely and keep the server running."},
{"n": 6, "label": "requested", "why": "\"server.js starts the server on the port in the PORT environment variable (default 3000)\""},
{"n": 7, "label": "implied", "why": "Visible focus and labelled squares are accessibility rigour on the requested playable board page, not extra capability."}
]}
